name: EcoTracker
description: AI-powered biodiversity tracking platform with multi-modal wildlife identification, community mapping, invasive species monitoring, and public observation data.

skills.name: Query Observations
skills.description: Read public biodiversity observations including species name, location, confidence score, and invasive status.

skills.name: Query Invasive Watchlist
skills.description: Read the curated list of invasive species with regional data and action tips.

skills.name: Query Announcements
skills.description: Read active platform announcements and biodiversity alerts.

skills.name: Identify Species
skills.description: Submit an image or audio file to identify wildlife species using AI vision and bioacoustic models.
